findings.text: test_logs is omitted from _PATH_LIST_KEYS although it is a path list whose entries are read one at a time (reckon/crew/reports.py:_cited_log_paths and _test_log_findings open each entry to read its command and EXIT line), so a joined test_logs is now accepted and read as one entry that cannot be read — probed at the reviewed head: parse_manifest('test_logs: logs/a.log; logs/b.log') returns ['logs/a.log; logs/b.log'] where the previous revision refused it — so the per-log command and EXIT checks silently pass, the same fail-open shape this section exists to close; the comment at reports.py:89-99 names only prose fields (artifacts, evidence_inputs, follow_ons, blockers) as the excluded set, but the set difference also drops this path field and commits.

commits is dropped from the refusal too, so a joined commit list parses to one entry — probed at the reviewed head: parse_manifest('commits: 1a2b3c4; 5d6e7f8') returns ['1a2b3c4; 5d6e7f8'] — a single citation token that names no commit, which the commit-citation guard reads as a citation while the second sha is never seen.

the comment states the write-scope audit consumes both fields' entries one by one, but orientation_write_paths is consumed as a set against the node's declared write paths at reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:388, where a joined value produces an orientation mismatch rather than a silent scope pass; the rationale for including it is real but the mechanism named is the wrong one.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against f86d1464: 1cf42c29e scopes the refusal to _PATH_LIST_KEYS and rewrites the tests, 5eb4dd58 rewrites the landing fragment to match; both stay inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: tests/test_a_joined_path_list_is_refused.py:74 refuses the measured changed_paths shape naming the field and the separator, :92 the joined orientation_write_paths, :102 and :118 keep the comma and JSON-array forms, and negative_control.log shows 4 failed at EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the reviewed commits' goal is to scope the joined-path-list refusal to the fields whose entries the write-scope audit reads; reckon/crew/reports.py:99 declares that set and :772 applies it, meeting the goal for changed_paths.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records seven tests passing, gate_after.log 254 passed, the importer arms at 247 passed each and the negative control at 4 failed, all EXIT=0 except the control at EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared write paths; every path in the two commits (reckon/crew/reports.py, tests/test_a_joined_path_list_is_refused.py, the evidence fragment) is inside them.

justifications.durability: the declared negative control removes the refusal call and four tests redden (negative_control.log, 4 failed, 3 passed, EXIT=1), so the refusal assertions fail on the reinstated comma-only reading; no test covers the test_logs list it no longer refuses.
justifications.evidence: the gate is recorded, not claimed: gate_after.log (254 passed, EXIT=0), gate_importers_base.log and gate_importers_head.log (247 passed each, EXIT=0), negative_control.log (4 failed, 3 passed, EXIT=1), all under the run directory.
justifications.fit: the new _PATH_LIST_KEYS set at reckon/crew/reports.py:99 and the reworded _refuse_joined_list_separator at :847 follow the module's surrounding style and carry no plan, ticket or version identifier, though the comment at :89-99 misstates orientation_write_paths' consumer.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/reports.py:772-773 scopes the refusal to _PATH_LIST_KEYS at reports.py:99, closing the prior review's two follow-ons (prose fields, orientation_write_paths), but the set drops test_logs, a path field whose joined value the parser now accepts.
justifications.reuse: no owner of a joined-path-list refusal exists; the split owner _coerce_list_field is extended rather than duplicated, while reports.py:139 and reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2789 name the same (*_MANIFEST_LIST_KEYS, 'orientation_write_paths') union the new set is drawn from.
justifications.scope_discipline: the two commits touch only reckon/crew/reports.py, tests/test_a_joined_path_list_is_refused.py and docs/evidence/fragments/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion/a-joined-path-list-is-refused.html, all inside the manifest's declared write paths.
